fields.Name: T229 - AI Agent Run Details Tab
fields.Description: Opens a completed AI Agent Run and switches to the Details tab, verifying the run's detail fields render.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' entity grid — type 'AI Agent Runs' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the 'MJ: AI Agent Runs' node (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=MJ:%20AI%20Agent%20Runs). Click a row whose Status is 'Completed', then click 'Open Full Record'. The AI Agent Run detail opens with a header (agent name, COMPLETED, Started/Completed/Duration/Result) and a row of tabs: Timeline, Visualization, Analytics, Details. Click the 'Details' tab. Verify the Details view renders the run's detail fields/metadata — e.g. the agent, status, started/completed timestamps, duration, result, and other run metadata — with no error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Completed AI Agent Run record opened
The 'Details' tab was selected and rendered the run's detail fields/metadata
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
